sentences.japanese: 民主主義者というのは、多数派の意思に従う自由な市民だ。
sentences.english: A democrat is a free citizen who yields to the will of the majority.

sentences.japanese: 君は法律に従わなければならない。
sentences.english: You are supposed to obey the law.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼女の忠告に従って行動すべきだったのにしなかった。
sentences.english: You should have acted on her advice.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼の忠告に従ったほうがよい。
sentences.english: You may as well follow his advice.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼の助言に従えさえすればよい。
sentences.english: All you have to do is follow his advice.
